question.problem:
The systolic blood pressure of adults in a given population is normally distributed with a mean of $123.4\,\text{mm}\,\text{Hg}$ and a standard deviation of $19.5\,\text{mm}\,\text{Hg}.$ Suppose $10$ adults are randomly selected. What is the probability that the mean systolic blood pressure for this sample will be between $120\,\text{mm}\,\text{Hg}$ and $125\,\text{mm}\,\text{Hg}?$ *Hint: A table of values of $Φ(z)$ for different values of $z$ is given below, where $Φ(z)$ is the cumulative distribution function for the standard normal distribution. *
$z$ $\,0.04\,$ $\,0.05\,$ $\,0.06\,$
$\,-0.5\,$ $\,0.2946\,$ $\,0.2912\,$ $\,0.2877\,$
$\,-0.4\,$ $\,0.3300\,$ $\,0.3264\,$ $\,0.3228\,$
$\,-0.3\,$ $\,0.3669\,$ $\,0.3632\,$ $\,0.3594\,$

$z$ $\,0.04\,$ $\,0.05\,$ $\,0.06\,$
$\,0.0\,$ $\,0.5160\,$ $\,0.5199\,$ $\,0.5239\,$
$\,0.1\,$ $\,0.5557\,$ $\,0.5596\,$ $\,0.5636\,$
$\,0.2\,$ $\,0.5948\,$ $\,0.5987\,$ $\,0.6026\,$
question.worked_solution:
If ${X}_{1},{X}_{2},…,{X}_{n}$ is a random sample of size $n$ from a normal population, where 

$$
{X}_{i}∼N(\mu ,{\sigma }^{2}),\,1\le i\le n,
$$

 then the sample mean $\overset{―}{X}$ has the distribution

$$
\overset{―}{X}∼N(\mu ,\frac{{\sigma }^{2}}{n}).
$$

We're told that the population mean $\mu =123.4,$ the population standard deviation $\sigma =19.5,$ and that the sample size $n=10.$ Therefore, the distribution of the sample mean $\overset{―}{X}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{X} & ∼N\,(123.4,\frac{{19.5}^{2}}{10}) \\  & ∼N(123.4,38.025).\end{aligned}
$$

We're required to find $P(120<\overset{―}{X}<125).$

First, we transform $X$ into a standard normal random variable $Z$ by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(120<\overset{―}{X}<125) & =P(\frac{120-123.4}{\sqrt{38.025}}<Z<\frac{125-123.4}{\sqrt{38.025}}) \\  & =P(-0.55<Z<0.26) \\  & =Φ(0.26)-Φ(-0.55)\end{aligned}
$$

From the table, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}Φ(-0.55) & =0.2912 \\ Φ(0.26) & =0.6026.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(120<\overset{―}{X}<125) & =Φ(0.26)-Φ(-0.55) \\  & ≈0.6026-0.2912 \\  & =0.3114.\end{aligned}
$$
